{{Quote|The escort frigate is on the move.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Drone Alone" />}}
This '''unidentified escort frigate''' was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], this frigate was used as an escort for a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[drone freighter]]s en route to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].
